p1_findings.finding: Waiting only covers an already-running exact watcher tag and has no timeout or periodic state receipt.
A noncooperating launch can race after the second query, and exact one-A800 UUID/model/driver/index0 is recorded but not enforced.
Major entrypoints, overlays and third-party roots are checked from the correct outer root, but repo-root import shadows and DSEC sample-content identity remain incomplete.
Failures before final publication may leave ambiguous attempt/result artifacts without FAILED_DO_NOT_CITE or partial quarantine.
Final semantics do not re-cross-check every factor receipt artifact hash and only type-check the propagated M513 identity.

The independent second verifier rechecks population, regular/no-symlink members, member hashes and outer seal, but does not explicitly reparse JSON semantics or exact completion text; integrity is inherited from the first verified seal.
The persisted END SHA is sampled before final staging, sealing and publication; there is no fourth true-end sample, although the reviewed source has no command after final rename.

mv -T is not renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE), and both Python verifiers resolve the staging root. Active external destination or staging-root replacement remains outside the accepted cooperative filesystem model.
